Ari (FinOps): Heads-up — I spotted a weird pair of lines on Feb invoice INV-2025-02-28: a CommittedUseDiscount_Adjustment credit, and then an equal ReservationCharge on a different billing account. Looks like the commitment benefit got applied to one account but the charge hit another. Anyone seen this pattern?
Ari (FinOps): Quick export snippet below (sanitized):
```
invoice_id, billing_account, reservation_id, sku_description, amount
INV-2025-02-28-1234, BA-1111, resv-0a1b2c, CommittedUseDiscount_Adjustment, -1200.00
INV-2025-02-28-1234, BA-2222, resv-0a1b2c, ReservationCharge - GPUs, 1200.00
```
Sam (Infra): Hmm — that reservation_id being on two billing accounts is suspicious. Did we recently move any dedicated pools or change billing tags?
Kai (EngOps): We migrated a Dedicated GPU pool from project-alpha to project-dedicated last week and updated the billing tag key from `dedicated:gpu` to `dedicated_pool:gpu-resv`. Might have been a partial propagation.
Maya (FinanceOps): Can you paste the BigQuery billing export path? I'll run a quick scoped query.
Ari (FinOps): `redwood-prod.billing_export.gcp_invoice.raw` — go for it.
Sam (Infra): Running quick query to see same reservation_id on different billing_account scopes:
```sql
SELECT billing_account_id, reservation_id, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `redwood-prod.billing_export.gcp_invoice`
WHERE invoice_month = '2025-02' AND reservation_id = 'resv-0a1b2c'
GROUP BY billing_account_id, reservation_id;
```
Sam (Infra): Result: BA-1111 -> -1200.00 (credit), BA-2222 -> 1200.00 (charge). So data confirms it.
Kai (EngOps): Likely root cause: when we changed tag key, the reservation consumer mapping (which determines billing scope) didn't update for some hosts — left a stale link to the old billing account. Cloud provider may still be attributing usage to whatever consumer_id was attached at time of usage.
billing-bot: Automated note: There was a reservations reparent operation performed on 2025-02-20 by infra-deploy-bot (ticket INFDEP-498).
Maya (FinanceOps): Ok. Action plan: 1) open cloud support ticket asking for duplicate ReservationCharge reversal and reapplication of commitment discount to BA-2222, 2) create internal Jira to reconcile and trigger a cost transfer if provider declines, 3) add a monthly audit to detect same reservation_id appearing across >1 billing_account.
Ari (FinOps): I'll file the provider support request — include invoice lines and reservation_id. Draft comment: "Reservation resv-0a1b2c produced both a CommittedUseDiscount_Adjustment (BA-1111) and a ReservationCharge (BA-2222) on the same invoice. Please confirm which billing_account should own the commitment and reverse the duplicate charge if misattributed."
Sam (Infra): Also will check reservation consumer attachments and the reparent operation logs. If we find infra caused the stale reference, we should auto-rollback the tag migration and re-run the reparent safely.
Kai (EngOps): Note for ops runbook: when changing billing tags or moving pools, ensure reservation_id -> billing_account mapping is explicitly validated with `gcloud`/provider API after the change.
Maya (FinanceOps): Created internal ticket FIN-3256 to track finance reconciliation and cost center impact. Assigned to Ari + Sam.
Ari (FinOps): Nice. Estimated impact: $1.2k this month; flagging for cost center owners.
Sam (Infra): Found the probe logs: one host still reported consumer_project = `project-alpha` until 2025-02-19 23:58 UTC, then got updated — that window likely consumed GPU hours billed to BA-2222.
Kai (EngOps): That matches the reparent timeframe from the deploy bot.
Maya (FinanceOps): I'll add a short-term rule in the monthly reconcile script to alert if any reservation_id has lines in >1 billing_account for the same invoice month.
Ari (FinOps): Thanks everyone. I'll paste the support ticket number once created and link INFDEP-498 + FIN-3256. :thumbsup:
Sam (Infra): 👍 I'll follow up with a remediation playbook once we confirm the provider's response.
Kai (EngOps): Good catch — this could have scaled if multiple reservations were migrated without validation.
Maya (FinanceOps): Agreed. Closing in thread for now until provider responds.
